decisions.what: Modified components/about/AboutSection.tsx instead of the specified components/About.tsx
decisions.why: The specified target components/About.tsx does not exist in the repository. The actual About section component containing the TeamGrid import and usage is at components/about/AboutSection.tsx, so that is the only file where removing TeamGrid can achieve the task's stated goal.

decisions.what: Removed the 'Meet the Team' header FadeIn block alongside the <TeamGrid /> usage
decisions.why: The header served only to introduce the team member grid. Leaving it after removing TeamGrid would produce dangling introductory copy with no content, breaking the About section's structural integrity that the spec asks to preserve.
